description: Voice chat no longer changes the Windows recording devices (B0002): no level or mute is set, so nothing needs restoring and a crash can't leave the microphone at 100%. winvoice_mic_mute mutes the game's own capture instead (the local player never counts as talking); winvoice_mic_reclevel no longer reaches the device (the capture gain is winvoice_mic_scaler; mapping the level onto it waits for groupvoice/record.cpp).
tests: tests/enhanced/test_voice.py: no winmm call and no mixer change from Voice_Init, Voice_Playback or Voice_Shutdown, everything else as the original; mute. tests/differential/run.py --enhanced: every other function still matches

functions: t6mp_msstore 140499A10 IN_MouseMove (enhanced/win32/win_input.cpp); 1401930F0 CL_MouseMove (enhanced/client/cl_input.cpp); new: the raw input thread (enhanced/win32/win_rawinput.cpp)
description: Raw mouse input with no acceleration and no smoothing (B0015, B0017, B0018). A thread of its own reads the mouse's raw input (WM_INPUT, device counts, 64-bit counters), so Windows' pointer speed and acceleration, the screen edges and the frame rate no longer change how far the view turns, and high polling rates cost the game nothing; menus keep the cursor. cl_mouseAccel and m_filter have no effect. A 0 ms frame keeps the movement for the next frame, and the yaw is kept within [-180, 180). Store build only, loaded into the game by runtime/loader (docs/enhanced-build.md).
tests: tests/enhanced/test_mouse.py: CL_MouseMove is the original at equivalent settings (P0003), accel and filter change nothing, 0 ms frames keep the movement, the yaw stays in range, IN_MouseMove gives the game the raw counts and is the original where they equal the cursor's movement, the counters and the window procedure, and the loader's patched exe entry points run the replacements. tools/runtime_link.py: no trap reachable from the replacements

description: Mouse sensitivity in MW2019's units: m_sens (default 1.5, 0.01 to 100, archived, registered on first use) turns the view by m_sens * 0.0066 degrees per count at any field of view, hip fire and aiming down sights alike; the profile's sensitivity, the FOV scale and m_yaw no longer apply to the mouse, m_pitch's sign still inverts. The view angles are kept in double precision between frames. Store build only.
tests: tests/enhanced/test_mouse.py: the original at equivalent settings (profile sensitivity m_sens * 0.3, FOV scale 1, m_yaw 0.022: same commands, calls and writes, angles within rounding), exact MW2019 turns whatever the FOV scale and profile, inverted pitch, the yaw within [-180, 180), two frames ending where one does, m_sens registered once with its range
